items.title: Open and reopen
items.steps: Open the installed app or browser viewer. Close and reopen it. Record crashes, blank screens or an unusually slow start.

items.title: Sign in and sign out
items.steps: Use your own test account. Record how many sign-in forms you see. Sign out and confirm private pages cannot be reopened without signing in.

items.title: Correct access
items.steps: Using test profiles only, confirm household users see the intended library and cannot use owner-only controls. Never include passwords in a report.

items.title: Browse and find media
items.steps: Search for an authorized sample, filter films / shows / music where available, and try an A–Z jump. Check artwork and poster positions.

items.title: Playback and seeking
items.steps: Play a short authorized sample. Pause, resume and seek. Note audio sync, buffering, format and quality. Test subtitles / audio tracks only if included in the build.

items.title: Resume and history
items.steps: Stop partway through a sample, reopen it and check progress. Use a separate profile to check history stays with the right person.

items.title: Visual layout
items.steps: Look for missing or black images, cropped text, overlap, large empty gaps and controls hidden behind headers. Try a smaller window or rotation where supported.

items.title: Readability and controls
items.steps: Try larger text, a keyboard / remote or screen reader if available. Check focus visibility, labels, contrast and reduced-motion settings.

items.title: Stability and performance
items.steps: Use the app for 10 minutes. Note freezes, heat, battery drain or unusual CPU / memory use if measured. Do not guess a measurement.

items.title: Connection changes
items.steps: With a short sample, test your permitted home and away connection. Compare the displayed direct / relay label. Note reconnection problems; do not disable security controls.

items.title: Settings and preferences
items.steps: Find a setting, change it, reopen the app and check it was saved. Record confusing names, duplicates or a missing option.

items.title: Install or update
items.steps: Install the assigned build, or update the existing app. Record warnings exactly. Check existing settings and files remain intact. Back up first.

items.title: Add media folders
items.steps: Add a folder containing copies of authorized samples. Confirm scanning and titles work without changing or deleting your originals.

items.title: Settings organization
items.steps: Try categories, search, Show all tabs and Appearance. Resize the window. Check every control remains reachable and A–Z jumps show the full poster.

items.title: Serve another device
items.steps: While the server is running, use a second device to sign in and play a short sample. Record both builds and the route label.

items.title: Install / update on phone
items.steps: Record version and build before and after updating. Check your account and preferences remain. Never uninstall to fix an update unless instructed.

items.title: Browse scrolling
items.steps: Scroll down: the search / filter area should move away while the alphabet remains reachable. Return to the top and check it reappears.

items.title: Game artwork
items.steps: Open Play. Check Sea Battle, Plate & Sign Hunt and Story Stew, then scan other cards for black or missing images.

items.title: Offline / Camp Mode — optional
items.steps: Only if supported in your build: prepare an authorized sample, disconnect internet and try it. Separately try Camp Mode with consenting nearby test devices.

items.title: Cast control — optional
items.steps: Check the Cast icon is visible. With a supported receiver on the same network, try discovery, playback, pause and disconnect.

items.title: Remote / controller navigation
items.steps: Reach every row using only the remote or controller. Check focus, Back, playback controls and on-screen keyboard.

items.title: Living-room readability
items.steps: From your usual viewing distance, check text size, safe screen edges, subtitles and the selected item.

items.title: Sleep / wake
items.steps: Pause, put the device to sleep, wake it and check that controls and playback recover.

items.title: Single sign-in and tabs
items.steps: Record the exact page and whether one username/password form opens the library. Required two-factor codes are a separate security step. Check refresh, Back and two test-profile tabs without sharing credentials.

items.title: Browser media controls
items.steps: Check fullscreen, volume, subtitles and returning from another tab. Record browser version. Only test available controls.

items.title: Package / container startup
items.steps: Record distribution, architecture and package / image version. Follow the provided guide. Note missing dependencies, file permissions or failed startup.

items.title: Restart and persistence
items.steps: Restart the app or your test container. Confirm media paths and preferences survive. Use backed-up test data.

items.title: Receiver discovery
items.steps: With permission, connect sender and receiver to the same network. Record device models and whether the receiver appears.

items.title: Cast and disconnect
items.steps: Play a short sample, pause, seek, change volume, then disconnect. Note which device controls playback and any audio / picture issues.

items.title: Attended screen sharing — optional
items.steps: Only on the assigned pilot with the owner present: check the request/approval flow. If separately approved, try pointer control. Stop sharing and confirm control ends. Do not share a sensitive screen.
